boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct ECU study settings, from silent library floors and reservable media rooms to outdoor tables and student-center workspaces.

cards.title: Settle Into the Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: Silent-focus seating in Joyner Library
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor when your work calls for a quiet setting; use the main elevator, then follow the posted floor directions.
cards.short_summary: Joyner’s designated quiet floor suits reading, outlining, and other concentration-heavy work.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU’s current Joyner Library floor map identifies the entire fourth floor as a quiet study floor and provides elevator-based directions.
cards.access_notes: Use during Joyner Library operating hours; the official floor map identifies the fourth floor as quiet study space.

cards.title: Take the Reading List Outside
cards.subtitle: Umbrella-shaded tables beside Joyner Library
cards.notes: Bring work that tolerates outdoor conditions and choose one of six umbrella tables; the courtyard also provides perimeter benches.
cards.short_summary: An accessible open-air option with shaded tables, benches, landscaping, and campus-made sculpture.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU states that Joyner Library’s wheelchair-accessible courtyard has six canopy-shaded tables seating four each and two additional benches.
cards.access_notes: Located off Joyner Library’s first floor; use is subject to library access and outdoor conditions.

cards.title: Tap Into the Graduate Lounge
cards.subtitle: Card-access workspace for graduate students
cards.notes: Bring your ECU ID for entry, then use the varied seating, whiteboards, or print-and-scan station to match the task at hand.
cards.short_summary: A graduate-only lounge combines flexible seating with whiteboards and document tools.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU describes the Graduate Lounge as a graduate-student study space with multiple seating choices, whiteboards, and a print station with scanning and email capability.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to graduate students; tap an ECU ID at the card reader to enter.

cards.title: Study With a Young Child Nearby
cards.subtitle: Reservable caregiver space on Joyner’s second floor
cards.notes: Reserve up to two hours and bring the child in your care; activity furniture, toys, puzzles, and a whiteboard support shared time.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-built room lets caregivers work while children use hands-on learning materials.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU documents a second-floor family study room with child-friendly activities and seating, available only to caregivers accompanied by children and reservable for up to two hours daily.
cards.source_title: Study options expand with new family room | Joyner Library | ECU
cards.access_notes: Only caregivers accompanied by children may use the room; reservations are limited to two hours per day.

cards.title: Adjust the Room to Your Focus
cards.subtitle: Calming second-floor drop-in study space
cards.notes: Drop in on a weekday and adjust the lighting or seating to your needs; fidgets, a tactile wall, and a monitor are available.
cards.short_summary: A sensory-aware room offers adjustable features for calmer, self-directed study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU identifies Joyner’s second-floor Sensory Space as a calming study option with adjustable lighting, varied seating, fidgets, a tactile wall, and a 55-inch monitor.
cards.source_title: Sensory space embraced on 2nd floor | Joyner Library | ECU
cards.access_notes: The cited ECU page documents weekday drop-in access from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; confirm current availability before visiting.

cards.title: Spread Out the Curriculum Materials
cards.subtitle: Consultation workspace inside Joyner’s TRC
cards.notes: Use the large shared table when reviewing books or curriculum materials, and ask TRC staff whether consultations affect availability.
cards.short_summary: A colorful lounge and oversized table support education-focused consultation and material review.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU’s Spring 2026 library publication describes the renovated TRC’s Collaboration Lounge as a large seating area with a table for spreading out books and curriculum materials during consultations.
cards.source_title: The Stacks Vol. 5, No. 1 Spring 2026 | Joyner Library | ECU
cards.access_notes: Located in the second-floor Teaching Resources Center; consultation use may affect availability, so check with TRC staff.

cards.entity_name: Music Library A/V Study Room A110C
cards.title: Reserve a Room for Media Work
cards.subtitle: A/V study room in Fletcher Music Center
cards.notes: Book Room A110C before a listening or viewing assignment; reservations open two weeks ahead and are capped at two hours daily.
cards.short_summary: A reservable Music Library room provides a defined setting for audiovisual coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: The ECU Music Library lists A/V Study Room A110C as reservable up to two weeks in advance for a maximum of two hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Reservation required for planned use; book no more than two weeks ahead and observe the two-hour daily maximum.

cards.entity_name: Laupus Health Sciences Library Study Rooms
cards.title: Put the Group Work on Screen
cards.subtitle: Technology-equipped rooms on the health sciences campus
cards.notes: Reserve a room for collaborative work that benefits from a large display or smart whiteboard, and review the booking terms first.
cards.short_summary: Thirty reservable rooms pair group workspace with presentation and whiteboard technology.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU reports that Laupus Library has 30 reservable study rooms and that every room includes a smart whiteboard and large LCD screen.
cards.source_title: ECU Libraries Overview | Joyner Library | ECU
cards.access_notes: Rooms are reservable; consult the current Laupus booking interface for eligibility, duration, and availability before arrival.

cards.title: Find a Lounge Between Classes
cards.subtitle: Study rooms and commons seating on main campus
cards.notes: Choose a lounge for independent work or a study room for collaboration, then confirm whether a room requires advance reservation.
cards.short_summary: The main student center offers study rooms, multiple lounges, and the expansive GUC Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU states that the Main Campus Student Center contains study rooms, multiple lounges, and the 10,000-square-foot GUC Commons for gathering and study.
cards.source_title: Main Campus Student Center | Student Centers | ECU
cards.access_notes: Enter during posted Student Center operating hours; meeting or study rooms may be governed by Central Reservations.

cards.title: Work Close to Clinical Classes
cards.subtitle: Quiet rooms, meeting space, and outdoor seating
cards.notes: Use a dedicated room for focused work or tutoring, or take weather-friendly assignments to the center’s outdoor seating area.
cards.short_summary: A health sciences campus hub provides several settings for solo work, tutoring, and group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU says the Health Sciences Student Center offers dedicated study rooms and meeting spaces for independent study, tutoring, and group projects, plus lounge and outdoor seating.
cards.source_title: Health Sciences Campus Student Center | Student Centers | ECU
cards.access_notes: Use during posted Student Center operating hours; check Central Reservations for any room-booking requirements.

warnings: The Sensory Space hours come from an official 2022 feature and should be reconfirmed before a visit.
Coordinates and map URLs are null because exact destination-level values were not verified from direct authoritative pages.
